name: Crisis Cleanup Web
humanitarian_domain: Collaborative disaster recovery and volunteer cleanup coordination

impact_evidence.claim: The repository README reports use across 207 disasters in 7 countries, connecting 600,000+ volunteers from 2,500+ organizations with 140,000+ households.
The README reports modeled monetary value and volunteer-efficiency estimates; these are useful scale proxies but not independently measured beneficiary outcomes.
